Now let me open the raster and report the metadata.

```python
import rasterio

with rasterio.open('/tmp/input_raster.tif') as src:
    print("CRS:", src.crs)
    print("Grid dimensions (width x height):", src.width, "x", src.height)
    print("Pixel size (res):", src.res)
    print("Nodata value:", src.nodata)
    print("Number of bands:", src.count)
    print("Bounds:", src.bounds)
    print("Data type:", src.dtypes)
```
